content: अखण्डित {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] .²1 Unbroken, undivided. .²2 Uninterrupted, perpetual, undisturbed, continuous; ˚ता मे वाणिज्या <ls>Mu. 1</ls>; अखण्डितं प्रेम लभस्व पत्युः <ls>Ku. 7. 28</ls> everlasting, unbroken. .²3 Unimpaired; unrefuted <ab>&c.</ab>; भट्टिन्या अखण्डितात् प्रणयात् <ls>M. 3</ls> never disappoinied; शतमखं तमखण्डितपौरुषम् <ls>R. 9. 13</ls> whose prowess knows no repulse or defeat.
